title: Tate's post-trip talk on solved energy

tellings.quote: I I saw while on this trip, we will never have to worry about energy. That's already been figured out.

plain: In 1948 the University of Minnesota physicist John Torrance Tate is said to have come back from a trip to the American Southwest and said, "I saw while on this trip, we will never have to worry about energy. That's already been figured out." The researcher Scott Ramsey tells this, crediting Tate's archived records and linking the trip to Vannevar Bush, the top US government science administrator of the era. Ramsey raises it as a hint that Tate had seen technology recovered from a crashed craft.
